parsed.explanation: Rating reflects no traveler-facing trans criminalization or universal facility/care restriction; strong anti-discrimination, hate-crime aggravation, migration protection, prison placement protocol, and legal-recognition climate. But severity if outed is mediated by documented capital violence (2021 hotel beating, 2023 homicide) with no recorded enforcement outcome, a pending incitement bill, police institutional-discrimination suit, and 2024 rights-regression signal. These are not an organised state campaign, so risk is below high, but absent evidence that remedies operate for trans victims prevents higher. Subnational variation is undocumented; incidents concentrated in the capital modestly lower expectation.
